title: Let the divided mind surrender into one direction
summary: The shabad names the mind's captivity under duality before it offers the turn. Through the Guru, surrender gathers scattered allegiance into one direction instead of letting the ego keep both thrones.
takeaway: Answer divided allegiance with one Guru-led act.
lifeApplication: Name the place where you are serving two masters. Choose one Guru-led act that costs the ego a small comfort, and complete it before the old argument resumes.

source.shortMeaning: Duality keeps the mind under divided rule; surrender through the Guru gathers it into oneness.
source.lifeApplication: Let the next decision reveal the allegiance you are no longer willing to feed.

evidence.coreClaim: The cited lines define duality as the mind's bondage and Guru-led surrender as the movement into oneness.
evidence.turn: The divided mind stops negotiating with itself and becomes one through surrender.
evidence.practicalImplication: Name the place where you are serving two masters. Choose one Guru-led act that costs the ego a small comfort, and complete it before the old argument resumes.
